Definition: a walk, i.e. (by implication) a step
BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, hâlîyk is the word for a walk, i.e. (by implication) a step. In Job 29:6, the text says "When I washed my steps with butter."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hâlîyk as it stands: a walk,  a step.
